name: yasc-syntax
description: tinycc's yasc dialect in C files: highlighting (owned/view/maybe/in/inout/out/drop, owned(dealloc)/borrows/takes, unsafe, cast<>/unsafe_cast<>, defer/errdefer, unreachable, error sets, !T, try/catch, modules, tagged unions, register fields, @min/@max), tcc's diagnostics, IntelliSense settings for the C/C++ extension

commands.title: yasc: Check this file with tcc

yasc.compiler.description: tcc that checks yasc files, relative to the workspace folder. Empty: the newer of libs/tinycc/bin/armv8m-tcc (build_rootfs.sh's cross) and libs/tinycc/armv8m-tcc (make cross), whichever runs on this machine.

yasc.ratchetConfig.description: The directories counted by scripts/safe_mode_ratchet.py are yasc, with their 'flags'.

yasc.files.description: More yasc files (globs relative to the workspace folder). A .c file with '#pragma yasc' is yasc anyway.

yasc.extraArgs.description: More tcc options for the check (e.g. -ccompat, -DFOO).

yasc.diagnostics.enable.description: Check yasc .c and .h files with 'tcc -fsyntax-only' (the safe default: yasc, -Wall, -Wlifetime).

yasc.diagnostics.onType.description: Check while typing (unsaved text goes to tcc on stdin), not only on open and save.

yasc.diagnostics.delay.description: Milliseconds after the last keystroke before checking.

yasc.diagnostics.timeout.description: Seconds before a check is given up.

yasc.intellisense.standard.description: The C standard IntelliSense parses yasc files as. tcc is C23, but IntelliSense's C23 mode reports a self-referencing struct as redeclared ('does not declare the same type', 3799).

yasc.intellisense.hideErrors.description: In yasc .c and .h files that tcc checks, show the C/C++ extension's errors only on lines where tcc reports an error too: IntelliSense parses plain C and cannot read @min/@max, slices ([]T, p[a:b], s.len), catch, !T. Its warnings and hints stay.

yasc.intellisense.enable.description: Give the C/C++ extension tcc's include paths and macros for yasc files and erase the yasc words it cannot parse (needs C_Cpp.default.configurationProvider = yasos.yasc-syntax).
